name: Greater Cushion The Blow [Psionic]
body:
Your damage prevention protects your ally for longer.

Prerequisite: Wisdom 17, Cushion the Blow, Improved Cushion the Blow, Collective class feature, manifester level 18th.

Benefit: When using the Cushion the Blow feat, the effect applies to all damage for that collective member until the beginning of your next turn.
